description.value: Cook & Pan is a Polish delicatessen and cafe established in 1996, now operating out of a restored heritage house in downtown Victoria. It combines an imported-goods deli, a fresh-sausage and cold-cuts counter, an espresso bar, and a kitchen turning out traditional dishes like pierogi, cabbage rolls, and bigos. A dedicated frozen take-home menu and an upstairs event space make it a distinctive stop for cyclists wanting a substantial, home-style Polish meal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is extensive and consistent across multiple subpages, confirming an active business at 1527 Amelia Street, Victoria with an espresso bar, deli, and full-service kitchen. The OSM name field reads 'Cook & Dan Polish Delicatessen & Cafe' but every page of the website uses 'Cook & Pan Polish Delicatessen & Cafe' — this is a clear OSM typographic error, so the website name is used per Rule 12 and flagged in concerns. No bike-specific amenities, washrooms, or Wi-Fi are mentioned anywhere on the site; takeout and vegan/vegetarian options are confirmed from website menu text.
concerns: OSM name field 'Cook & Dan Polish Delicatessen & Cafe' is a typographic error; the website consistently uses 'Cook & Pan Polish Delicatessen & Cafe' on every page. The OSM record should be corrected to 'Cook & Pan'.
